title: Gwadar Industrial Estates Development Authority Amendment Act 2012

sections.shortTitle: Gwadar Industrial Estates Development Authority Amendment Act 2012
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

GWADAR INDUSTRIAL ESTATES DEVELOPMENT
GWADAR INDUSTRIAL ESTATES
DEVELOPMENT
AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT,
2012
An Act to further amend the Gwadar Industrial Estates
Development Authority Act, 2009
(Act Nol.II of 2009)
[Gazette of Balochistan,
Extraordinary,
14th April, 2012]
No.PAB/Legis:V(02)/2012, dated 14-4-2012.---Having been
passed the Gwadar Industrial Estates Development
Authority (Amendment) Bill No.2 of 2012 by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 30th March, 2012 and assented to by the
Governor, Balochistan on 12th April, 2012 is hereby
published as an Act of the Balochistan Provincial
Assembly.
Preamble.---Whereas, it
is expedient to amend the Gwadar Industrial Estates
Development Authority Act, 2009 (Act No.II of 2009),
in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1)
This Act may be called the Gwadar Industrial
Development Authority (Amendment) Act, 2012.
(2)
It shall come into force at once.
